Toward Convergent Adam-Type Methods

A deep learning method for computing the spectrum of the Schrödinger operator: numerics and analysis
Abstract: We present a novel deep learning method for computing eigenstates of the Schrödinger operator. Our approach combines a novel loss function with an innovative neural network architecture that incorporates a-prior knowledge of the problem.
